[OVERVIEW] DESCRIPTION

Solar-powered autonomous seeding and weeding robot from Denmark. Seeds with GPS precision, then returns to weed exactly between seeds without cameras. 100% solar, zero emissions. Covers 20+ hectares.

[EDITORIAL] ROBOTOMATED VERDICT

The FarmDroid FD20 earns a RoboScore of 78/100, placing it in the solid tier for agricultural and farming robots. At $60,000 it sits in the enterprise segment, making it a reasonable choice for teams where coverage area and weather resilience is the priority. FarmDroid delivers a competent platform at this price point. Seasonal deployment patterns and field conditions must factor into ROI calculations.

[EDITORIAL] WHO THIS ROBOT IS FOR

Large-scale operations with integration teams, fleet management capabilities, and multi-year deployment plans. If coverage area and weather resilience is your primary decision criterion, the FarmDroid FD20 deserves a place on your shortlist.

[EDITORIAL] WHO SHOULD LOOK ELSEWHERE

Small operations without dedicated integration resources or where payback period exceeds 3 years. If your requirements center on a different set of capabilities, compare alternatives in the agricultural category before committing.

[FAQ] COMMON QUESTIONS
How much does the FarmDroid FD20 cost?
The FarmDroid FD20 is currently priced at $60,000. Total cost of ownership including maintenance, integration, and training is typically 1.5-2.5x the purchase price over 5 years.
What certification do I need to operate the FarmDroid FD20?
Operators should hold at minimum an RCO Foundation (Level 1) certification. For programming and integration work, RCO Specialist (Level 2) is recommended.
How long does it take to deploy the FarmDroid FD20?
Deployment timelines for Agricultural robots typically range from 2-12 weeks depending on facility complexity and integration requirements.
Should I buy, lease, or hire the FarmDroid FD20?
Buy if you plan to use it for 3+ years at high utilization. Lease (typically $1,667/month) if you want flexibility and upgrades. Hire through RoboWork if you need it for a project or pilot — no capital expenditure required.
How does the FarmDroid FD20 compare to alternatives?
With a RoboScore of 78/100, the FarmDroid FD20 scores competitively for Agricultural. Use our comparison tool to evaluate it against up to 2 other robots across all 8 scoring dimensions.
